response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS award_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), award_total AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total FROM award_counts) SELECT ac.player_id, ac.award_count, 1.0 * ac.award_count / at.total AS fraction FROM award_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN award_total AS at WHERE at.total > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
